emails.job: Help the reader picture using Buffer for one ordinary week and get them to compare the official plans against that workload.
emails.single_idea: At the start of the week, queue a few posts for your connected social channels; after they publish, check engagement, impressions, and individual post performance in Buffer before planning the next week. The Free plan supports up to 10 scheduled posts per channel at one time, so present it as a practical entry point with a clear limit—not as unlimited scheduling.
must_not_say: Do not presume the reader currently posts natively, uses another tool, relies on a spreadsheet, or follows a manual process.

Do not imply every connected channel supplies identical analytics or metrics.
Do not imply Google Business Profile performance can be inspected in Insights.
Do not present the workflow as a rigid prescription; it is a concrete example the reader can adapt.
emails.felt_need: Keep the week’s social posts organized and use basic results to make the next round less guesswork-driven.
emails.mechanism: Buffer combines a post queue with Insights alongside the publishing workflow: schedule a small weekly batch across connected channels, then review basic post-performance signals in the same product.
emails.next_step_decision: Decide whether the Free plan can support this small weekly queue or whether a paid plan is appropriate for a larger schedule.

events.body:
Queue a few posts at the start of the week, then check what landed before planning the next batch.

Buffer is a social media workspace for scheduling posts across connected channels and reviewing their performance. Add your weekly posts to the queue, let them publish, then check the engagement, impressions, and individual post-performance data available in Insights.

It’s a simple loop you can adapt: plan, queue, review, and use the results to inform what you post next.

The Free plan includes the queue and supports **up to 10 scheduled posts per channel at one time**. Paid plans include unlimited scheduled posts per channel.

Compare Buffer plans to see whether Free fits your weekly queue or a paid plan suits a larger schedule.

Foster Coffee Company found that planning two weeks ahead worked well while still leaving room to move posts and add timely shop content. Your own rhythm can be shorter or longer.

The official plan comparison shows whether that rhythm fits Free, with **10 scheduled posts per channel at one time**, or a paid plan with unlimited scheduled posts per channel.

Monday’s queue doesn’t have to decide Friday’s post.

Buffer is a social media workspace for scheduling posts across connected channels and checking how they performed. Queue a few posts for the week, then click and drag one to another slot when a timely local update takes priority.

Foster Coffee Company found that planning two weeks ahead gave it room to stay prepared while still rearranging posts and adding timely shop content. After posts publish, you can check engagement and impressions before planning the next batch.

The Free plan holds **10 scheduled posts per channel** at one time. Paid plans provide unlimited scheduled posts per channel, subject to a 5,000-post fair-use cap.

The official comparison shows those allowances side by side, so you can see which fits your planned volume.
